story.title: Summer signings join Lionel Messi among MLS’s top earners: Takeaways from the league’s salary release
story.summary: How much in player salaries did it take to earn a point in the 2026 MLS regular season? The latest batch of salaries lends some insightLionel Messi has closer company at the top of MLS’s list of highest-paid players, thanks to another pair of former Barcelona attackers. The Inter Miami captain is still comfortably the league’s top earner, on a guaranteed compensation of $28.3m. Robert Lewandowski
